senses.definition: (settle down (?), Arabic أَهَلَ be inhabited, cf. Assyrian âlu, settlement, city, maʾâlu, maʾâltu, bed; DlW & Pr 105 NöZMG xi (1886), 154, 720 doubts אֹהֶל = أَهْلٌ = âlu; but أَهْل = dwelling actually in vulg.Ar. ac. to SoBuhl).
